model_organism.citation: Peña-Münzenmayer et al. 2015 - Ae4 (Slc4a9) Anion Exchanger Drives Cl- Uptake-dependent Fluid Secretion by Mouse Submandibular Gland Acinar Cells (PMID: 25745107)
phenotypes: Saliva secretion reduced by ~35% in Ae4-/- submandibular glands after muscarinic and β-adrenergic stimulation
Reduced HCO3--dependent Cl- uptake in acinar cells, most evident during β-adrenergic/cAMP signaling
Nkcc1 and Na+/H+ exchanger activity not changed
Ae2-/- mice had normal salivation, but reduced HCO3--dependent Cl- uptake
Cl-/HCO3- exchanger activity nearly abolished in double Ae4/Ae2 knockout acinar cells

model_organism.citation: 2025 - SLC4A9 deficiency is involved in Sjögren's syndrome and enamel defects through RPS27-triggered ribosomal stress (PMID: 42855468)
phenotypes: Salivary impairment with reduced saliva secretion
Female-predominant salivary gland inflammation and autoantibody production (Sjögren's-like)
Enamel malformation with delayed ameloblast differentiation
Disrupted Cl-/pH homeostasis with RPS27 upregulation and ribosomal stress
p53-dependent cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis in glandular and enamel lineages

model_organism.citation: Singh et al. 2007 - PAT-1 (Slc26a6) is the predominant apical membrane Cl-/HCO3- exchanger in the upper villous epithelium of the murine duodenum (PMID: 17170027)
phenotypes: Basal apical Cl-/HCO3- exchange activity in the upper villous duodenal epithelium reduced by <5% in AE4(-) (Slc4a9-null) mice vs WT, i.e. negligible contribution
SO4(2-)/HCO3- exchange not affected in AE4(-) duodenum

biological.citation: Ae4 (Slc4a9) is an electroneutral monovalent cation-dependent Cl-/HCO3- exchanger (PMID: 27114614)
biological.summary: Native Ae4 in mouse salivary acinar cells and heterologously expressed mouse Ae4 and human AE4 in CHO-K1 cells mediate Na+-dependent Cl-/HCO3- exchange. Na+ moves with HCO3- and the transport is electroneutral. Ae4 also works with K+, Cs+, Li+ and Rb+, so it is a Cl-/nonselective cation-HCO3- exchanger.

biological.citation: Ae4 (Slc4a9) Anion Exchanger Drives Cl- Uptake-dependent Fluid Secretion by Mouse Submandibular Gland Acinar Cells (PMID: 25745107)
biological.summary: Ae4-/- mice had 35% less saliva secretion, with reduced Cl- uptake during β-adrenergic/cAMP stimulation. Nkcc1 and NHE activity were unchanged. Cl-/HCO3- exchange was nearly abolished in Ae2/Ae4 double knockouts, so Ae4 is needed for cAMP-dependent fluid secretion.

biological.citation: Activation of the Ae4 (Slc4a9) cation-driven Cl-/HCO3- exchanger by the cAMP-dependent protein kinase in salivary gland acinar cells (PMID: 34585968)
biological.summary: Ae4 activity in Ae2-/- submandibular acinar cells increased with β-adrenergic stimulation, and H89 (a PKA inhibitor) blocked this. In CHO-K1 cells, co-expressing PKAc increased Ae4 activity. The S173A mutant was not activated by PKA, whereas S273A still was, suggesting Ae4 is regulated through S173 phosphorylation.

biological.citation: The forkhead transcription factor Foxi1 directly activates the AE4 promoter (PMID: 16159312)
biological.summary: AE4 (Slc4a9) is specifically expressed in type B intercalated cells of the renal collecting duct and is absent in Foxi1-null mice. In reporter assays Foxi1 activated the AE4 promoter about 100-fold through one binding site within about 462 bp upstream of the transcription start. Mutating that site abolished both Foxi1 binding and activation, making Slc4a9 a direct Foxi1 target.

biological.citation: Disrupting Hypoxia-Induced Bicarbonate Transport Acidifies Tumor Cells and Suppresses Tumor Growth (PMID: 27197160)
biological.summary: Hypoxia induced SLC4A9 and SLC4A4 expression in cancer cell lines in a manner dependent on HIF1α and HIF2α. SLC4A9 disruption acidified intracellular pH, reduced spheroid growth and increased apoptosis. SLC4A9 RNAi strongly reduced growth of MDA-MB-231 breast tumor and U87 glioma xenografts in mice.

biological.citation: A novel sodium bicarbonate cotransporter-like gene in an ancient duplicated region: SLC4A9 at 5q31 (PMID: 11305939)
biological.summary: SLC4A9 was discovered on chromosome 5q31. It encodes a 990-aa protein with 12 transmembrane domains and a 23-exon gene with 14 mRNA isoforms, produced by extensive alternative splicing. Expression is largely restricted to kidney. It lies in a paralogous EGF-SLC4A-ANK-FGF gene cluster.

biological.citation: SLC4A9 deficiency is involved in Sjögren's syndrome and enamel defects through RPS27-triggered ribosomal stress (PMID: 42855468)
biological.summary: SLC4A9 missense variants were found in three amelogenesis imperfecta cases, and copy number variations with reduced SLC4A9 expression in a Sjögren's syndrome patient. Slc4a9 knockout mice showed reduced salivary secretion, glandular inflammation, and enamel malformation. Loss of SLC4A9 disrupted Cl-/pH homeostasis, upregulated RPS27, caused ribosomal stress and p53-dependent arrest and apoptosis, and Nutlin-3a reduced the inflammation.
biological.sample_size: 3 amelogenesis imperfecta cases, 1 Sjögren's patient, KO mice

biological.citation: Epigenome-Wide Association Study for All-Cause Mortality in a Cardiovascular Cohort Identifies Differential Methylation in CASZ1 (PMID: 31642367)
biological.summary: In the EWAS validation set, the SLC4A9 CpG cg08215811 was differentially methylated in cases with all-cause mortality (log2 FC = -0.14). It remained significant in the meta-analysis (FDR<0.05). The SLC4A9 transcript failed quality control, so its expression could not be assessed.
biological.sample_size: Discovery 55 cases/49 controls; validation 108 cases/108 controls
biological.significance: FDR-adjusted P<0.10 in validation; FDR<0.05 in meta-analysis

biological.citation: Effect of heat stress on the gene expression of ion transporters/channels in the uterus of laying hens during eggshell formation (PMID: 29115887)
biological.summary: SLC4A9 is expressed in the uterine lining of laying hens during eggshell formation. Heat stress reduced SLC4A9 transcript by 66.1%, along with ITPR3 and SLC4A4, which may impair Cl-/HCO3-/Na+ transport during eggshell mineralization.

biological.citation: Integrated compensatory network is activated in the absence of NCC phosphorylation (PMID: 25893600)
biological.summary: In SPAK kinase-deficient mice, which cannot activate NCC, Slc4a9 was coordinately induced along with Slc26a4 and Slc4a8, carbonic anhydrases and V-ATPase subunits in pendrin-positive intercalated cells. This forms a compensatory NaCl reabsorption transport system.
